description: This file defines an interface IController with several methods related to system control and configuration, designed as a deprecated interface within the WPEFramework plugin host namespace.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for controlling various aspects of the system, including persistence, reboot, environment, configuration, and cloning functionalities. Marked as deprecated.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists current state or data to storage.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes data or files at the specified path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves the environment variables or data associated with the given index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration associated with the given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone with a new callsign from a base callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
